name: Reflowable e-book
definition: a book package whose text reflows to the screen.

name: Fixed-layout e-book or PDF
definition: a file that keeps a fixed page, including a fixed-page text book and a scanned document saved as PDF or DjVu.

name: Comic or manga file
definition: a book whose pages are drawn or photographed images, read page by page or by vertical scroll (comic, manga, bande dessinée, webtoon), held in any container.

name: Text or word-processor file
definition: a bare text or word-processor file with no e-book package.

name: Digital sheet music
definition: a music score held as a file.

name: Digital music file
definition: Music held as an audio file, whether lossy, lossless compressed or uncompressed. Compression and resolution describe the file.

name: Audiobook file
definition: A book read aloud, kept as a file or set of files, either open or locked to an account, and either abridged or unabridged.

name: Podcast episode file
definition: an episode of a podcast kept as a file.

name: Digital video
definition: film, TV, home video or video artwork held as a video file or as a purchased locker entitlement with no file held, any unit (title, episode, season).

name: Camera raw photo
definition: an unprocessed image as recorded by a camera's sensor.

name: JPEG-type photo file
definition: a photograph or raster image saved with lossy compression.

name: Lossless image file
definition: a pixel image saved uncompressed or with lossless compression.

name: Layered image file
definition: a raster image file that keeps separate editable layers.

name: Vector graphic file
definition: an image made of shapes and paths that scales without loss.

name: Digital font
definition: A typeface family kept as font files under a licence. The licence scope (desktop, web, app, server) varies for the same family.

name: Design template
definition: a layout file sold to be filled in or adapted in a design tool, including a PDF sewing or knitting pattern.

name: Brush pack
definition: a set of brushes for a drawing or painting program.

name: Background, texture and frame pack
definition: a pack of image materials sold for use in making other work.

name: Motion graphics template
definition: an editable animated-graphics project file for a video or motion tool.

name: Digital planner
definition: a planner or organiser held as a file to write in on a device.

name: 3D model
definition: a three-dimensional model held as a file to import into tools, including an avatar model.

name: 3D material
definition: a surface material or shader definition for 3D rendering.

name: 3D lighting
definition: an environment lighting map or light setup for 3D rendering.

name: Sample pack or instrument library
definition: recorded sounds or a sampled instrument held as files for a music program.

name: Preset or LUT pack
definition: saved settings or colour look-up tables loaded by an editing or sound program.

name: MIDI file
definition: a file of note and control data that a program plays or edits.

name: AI model file
definition: AI model weights held as a file.

name: Character outfit or skin
definition: an item that changes the look of a player's character or agent.

name: Avatar accessory
definition: a worn add-on item for a character, such as back items, shoes, gloves or banners.

name: Companion
definition: a pet or sidekick that accompanies a player's character.

name: Weapon skin
definition: a finish that changes the look of an in-game weapon.

name: Tool and glider skin
definition: an item that changes the look of an in-game tool or traversal gear (pickaxe, glider, trails).

name: Wrap
definition: a finish applied across the surfaces of vehicles, weapons or other items.

name: Emote
definition: an animation or dance a player's character performs on command.

name: Spray
definition: an image a player places on surfaces in the game world.

name: In-game sticker or charm
definition: a sticker, patch or charm applied to an in-game item.

name: Chat emoticon
definition: a small image used in a game's or platform's chat.

name: Music kit
definition: an item that replaces a game's music or lobby track.

name: Messaging sticker pack
definition: a set of stickers used in a messaging platform's chats.

name: Loot crate
definition: an item that opens to give one or more random items.

name: Crate key
definition: an item that opens a loot container.

name: Trading card
definition: A collectible card kept in a game platform account. A foil card is a shinier version of the same card.

name: Profile background
definition: an image item shown behind a platform profile.

name: Badge or pin
definition: a badge or pin item shown on a platform profile or in a game.

name: Open domain name
definition: A domain name registered under a generic ending (such as .com) that anyone may register.

name: Country-code domain name
definition: a domain-name registration under a country-code TLD that is not reserved to a registrant class.

name: Restricted domain name
definition: A domain name registered under an ending, or a second-level name, that only certain kinds of registrant may use.

name: Unique NFT
definition: A non-fungible token that is the only one with its token number.

name: Multi-edition NFT
definition: A token issued in several identical copies under one token number.

name: Loading screen
definition: An image item collected in a game account and shown on the player's screen while a match loads.

name: Vehicle skin
definition: An item that changes the body or parts (wheels) of an in-game vehicle.

name: Profile avatar
definition: A picture item, still or animated, used as the account's profile picture on a platform.

name: Avatar frame
definition: A decorative frame item shown around a platform profile picture.
